lines: Tere khushboo mein base khat main jalata kaise
couplets.en: How could I burn the letters that still held your fragrance?

lines: Pyaar mein doobe hue khat main jalata kaise
couplets.en: How could I burn letters steeped in love?

lines: Tere haathon ke likhe khat main jalata kaise
couplets.en: How could I burn the letters you wrote with your own hands?

lines: Jinko duniya ki nigahon se chhupaye rakha
couplets.en: I kept them hidden from the eyes of the world.

lines: Jinko ik umr kaleje se lagaye rakha
couplets.en: I held them close to my heart for a lifetime.

lines: Deen jinko, jinhen imaan banaye rakha
couplets.en: I held them sacred and made them my faith.

lines: Tere khushboo mein base khat main jalata kaise
couplets.en: How could I burn the letters that still held your fragrance?

lines: Jinka har lafz mujhe yaad tha paani ki tarah
couplets.en: I knew every word by heart, as familiar as water.

lines: Mujhko pyaare the jo anmol nishani ki tarah
couplets.en: They were dear to me, like a keepsake beyond price.

lines: Tune duniya ki nigahon se jo bachkar likhe
couplets.en: You wrote them beyond the world's gaze.
Year after year, you kept writing to me.

lines: Kabhi din mein to kabhi raat ko uthkar likhe
couplets.en: You wrote sometimes by day, sometimes rising in the night.

lines: Tere khushboo mein base khat main jalata kaise
couplets.en: How could I burn the letters that still held your fragrance?

lines: Tere khat aaj main Ganga mein baha aaya hoon
couplets.en: Today I let the Ganges carry your letters away.

lines: Aag behte hue paani mein laga aaya hoon
couplets.en: I set fire to the flowing water.

lines: Tere khushboo mein base khat main jalata kaise
couplets.en: How could I burn the letters that still held your fragrance?
